parts.ideal: No function past complexity 10 or 50 lines, and no file past 300 lines
parts.setup: Split the worst function first; the tab lists every item over a limit

parts.ideal: No unused file, export, package or function, and no comment naming a file that is gone
parts.setup: knip reads JavaScript, Python's ast reads Python; delete what they list

parts.ideal: Every shared function says what it does on the line where it starts
parts.setup: A header comment in JavaScript, a docstring in Python

parts.ideal: Every file and folder follows the naming rule of its folder
parts.setup: Name the rules once in the repo's targets; the tab lists each name that breaks one

parts.ideal: Imports run one way, with no cycle between files
parts.setup: Move the shared piece to a file both sides import

parts.ideal: Every code area is drawn in a table or a diagram a reader lands on
parts.setup: A table row or a Mermaid block in a README, or in a doc it links

parts.ideal: The guard judges a command within a tenth of a second
parts.setup: Time it where sessions run; keep imports and rule loading off the hot path

parts.ideal: Every file fits one Read call and every area fits one context window

quality: No function past complexity 10 or 50 lines, no file past 300, nothing unused or uncommented, no import cycle, every area drawn from its README.
speed: The guard, which runs before every command, answers within a tenth of a second.
consumption: Every file fits one Read call of 25,000 tokens, and every area fits a 200K-token context window.
